item.title: Trump says Iran targets will expand, honors U.S. troops killed in war
item.summary: President Donald Trump honors slain U.S. service members at Dover, threatens to widen U.S. targets after Iran’s president dismissed the notion of surrender.

item.title: Laden Iranian ships depart Chinese port tied to key military chemicals
item.summary: Experts said the vessels are probably carrying a key precursor for rocket fuel, making it notable that Beijing let them sail while the U.S. and Iran are at war.

item.title: Trump team bashed Europe for a year. Now he wants support in war on Iran.
item.summary: European leaders are ramping up their response to the crisis spreading outside Iran but remain wary of a conflict that could have untold ramifications.

item.title: Intel report warns large-scale war ‘unlikely’ to oust Iran’s regime
item.summary: A classified U.S. report doubts that Iran’s opposition would take power following either a short or extended U.S. military campaign.

item.title: Why is the U.S. at war with Iran? Here’s what the Trump administration says.
item.summary: President Donald Trump and top administration officials have offered a range of rationales for launching Operation Epic Fury.

item.title: Trump demands ‘UNCONDITIONAL SURRENDER’ from Iran; U.S. evacuates citizens from Middle East
item.summary: On Day 7 of the war, Israel launched attacks on Tehran and bombarded Lebanon. Iran retaliated against Israel and the region.

item.title: Unprepared for Iranian drones, U.S. and partners seek Ukraine’s help
item.summary: Swarms of low-cost drones used by the Russians in Ukraine have been breaching U.S. air defense systems and striking targets across the Middle East.

item.title: Russia is providing Iran intelligence to target U.S. forces, officials say
item.summary: The targeting information has included the locations of American warships and aircraft in the Middle East, the officials said.

item.title: Video appears to show the moment a Kuwaiti fighter jet accidentally shot down a U.S. F-15
item.summary: Three U.S. fighter jets involved in the offensive against Iran were shot down mistakenly by Kuwait’s air defenses, the U.S. military’s Central Command said.

item.title: Ukrainian forces halt advance in Zaporizhzhia, Kyiv officials say
item.summary: Ukraine has claimed a slew of successes on the front line in recent days, underscoring the effectiveness of its weapons systems, including anti-drone interceptors.
